title: OTT Advertising—Everything You Need to Know About Over the Top

facts.fact: The page cites a $167.4B local advertising market, with the accompanying chart labeled as 2022 local advertising spend.
facts.quote: OTT is becoming an increasingly important segment of the [$167.4B local advertising market]

facts.fact: The page states that OTT local advertising spend grew 57% to reach $2B in 2022.
facts.quote: After growing by 57% to reach $2B in 2022, OTT spend is expected to reach $3.5B by 2026

facts.fact: The page states that OTT local advertising spend is expected to reach $3.5B by 2026.
facts.quote: OTT spend is expected to reach $3.5B by 2026

facts.fact: A local TV group executive interviewed by BIA reported that his station's digital revenue reached 25% of total revenue through programmatic OTT audience extension.
facts.quote: his station has grown its digital revenue to **25% of total revenue**

facts.fact: According to the BIA-interviewed executive, the station's digital revenue has been growing up to 20% annually.
facts.quote: this has been **growing up to 20% annually**

facts.fact: A study conducted by NBCU and iSpot states that 30% to 40% of TV ad campaigns' impressions should come from over-the-top streaming to optimize results.
facts.quote: 30% to 40% of TV ad campaigns’ impressions should come from over-the-top streaming in order to optimize results.

facts.fact: The page cites Conviva stating that on most streaming services, CTV represents over 80% of all viewing.
facts.quote: CTV represents over 80% of all viewing

facts.fact: The page defines CTV advertising as a subset of OTT advertising that plays on an actual television set, either directly on a smart TV or via a streaming device.
facts.quote: [**CTV advertising**](https://madhive.com/resources/article/CTV-advertising) is a subset of OTT advertising and includes advertising played on an actual television set

facts.fact: The page defines Subscription Video on Demand (SVOD) as a recurring fee model for access to a library of subscription content, such as Netflix or Disney+.
facts.quote: A recurring fee model for access to a library subscription content (e.g. Netflix, Disney+)

facts.fact: The page defines Advertising-Based Video on Demand (AVOD) as an ad-supported distribution model, such as Hulu with ads.
facts.quote: Provides an ad-supported distribution model (e.g. Hulu with ads)

facts.fact: The page is published by Madhive Marketing and dated August 13, 2024.
